title: Mixed DI Sets — All Chart Types
tagline: Year 4 — Bar, line, pie and table in one set: converting each view to numbers and chaining them

introduction.overview: A mixed DI set gives several kinds of chart in one set: a bar chart for totals, a line chart for a rate, a pie chart for shares and a table for category rates. The way through is to convert every chart into numbers first, and then to chain them: total × share = category amount, amount × rate = profit. Check that percentages in a pie add to 100 and that you apply each rate to the right base.
introduction.placementRelevance: Mixed sets are the capstone DI items in company tests.
introduction.realWorldContext: Board packs combine all four views in exactly this way.

learningObjectives: Convert bar, line, pie and table to numbers
Compare growth and margins across views

prerequisiteKnowledge.quickRefresher: Category sales = total × share. Category profit = category sales × margin. Overall profit = total × overall margin.

coreDefinitions: Line chart: a rate across periods.
Pie chart: shares of a whole.
conceptExplanation.theoreticalIntuition: All four views describe the same business; each gives one factor of the answer.
conceptExplanation.visualOrMentalModel: Write numbers beside each chart, compute the category table, then answer.

importantRulesAndFormulas.title: Reconcile
importantRulesAndFormulas.formula: Sum of category profits vs overall

mainNarrative: 2023 sales are ₹1,200 crore; by category: Electronics 384, Apparel 288, Grocery 336, Home 192 (sum 1,200).
Category profits: Electronics 8% = 30.72; Apparel 15% = 43.2; Grocery 6% = 20.16; Home 12% = 23.04; total 117.12 crore.
The overall margin on the line chart for 2023 is 14%, giving 168 crore. The two figures differ (117.12 versus 168), so the data are not reconciled; questions will state which to use.

deepDiveAspects.title: Inconsistent views
deepDiveAspects.content: In real data two views may not reconcile; use the one the question names.

commonMistakes.mistake: Applying a margin to the wrong base

placementTips.eliminationTechnique: Category sales cannot exceed total sales.
